bash_command

cat << 'EOF' > read_pages.py
import re
with open("confluence_bodies.txt") as f:
    text = f.read()

sections = text.split("=== PAGE ")
for s in sections[1:]:
    lines = s.split("\n", 1)
    header = lines[0]
    body = lines[1] if len(lines) > 1 else ""
    clean = re.sub(r'</?(p|h[1-6]|li|tr|div|br|ul|ol|table)[^>]*>', '\n', body)
    clean = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', clean)
    clean = re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+', '\n', clean)
    print(f"=== PAGE {header}")
    print(clean.strip()[:3000])
    print("\n" + "="*40 + "\n")
EOF

import json
import re
import html

with open("all_pages_full.json") as f:
    pages = json.load(f)

for p in pages:
    body = p.get("body", {}).get("storage", {}).get("value", "")
    clean = html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', body))
    clean = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', clean)
    matches = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'\bnotes?\b', clean, re.I)]
    if matches and re.search(r'transfer', clean, re.I):
        for idx in matches:
            snippet = clean[max(0, idx-120):min(len(clean), idx+180)]
            if re.search(r'transfer|transaction|tx|tran|copy|copied|attach|create|populate|rail|book|ach', snippet, re.I):
                print(f"[Page {p['id']}: {p['title']}] ...{snippet}...")
EOF
